issue.title: [ML] Fix datafeed checks when a concrete remote index is present

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
A bug was introduced in 6.6.0 when we added support for rollup indices. Rollup caps does NOT support looking at remote indices, consequently, since we always look up rollup caps, the datafeed fails with an error if its config includes a concrete remote index.  (When all remote indices in a datafeed config are wildcards the problem did not occur.)

The rollups feature does not support remote indices, so if there is any remote index in a datafeed config (wildcarded or not), we can skip the rollup cap checks.  This PR implements that change.

Fixes #42113

body:
I think the problem is in the `RemoteClusterConnection` class: https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/b9ce649fad6cd410112cb9260bbb229d9d009adc/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/transport/RemoteClusterConnection.java#L210

I think that call to get the remote cluster state for the purpose of checking which nodes exist should be done in the system context, like in https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/b9ce649fad6cd410112cb9260bbb229d9d009adc/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/cluster/metadata/TemplateUpgradeService.java#L134

issue.title: Use system context for looking up connected nodes

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
When finding nodes in a connected cluster for cross cluster
search the requests to get cluster state on the connected
cluster should be made in the system context because
logically they are equivalent to checking a single detail
in the local cluster state and should not require that the
user who made the request that is using this method in its
implementation is authorized to view the entire cluster
state.

Fixes #43974

issue.title: Machine Learning not working with non-wildcarded alias and cross cluster search

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
**Elasticsearch version** (`bin/elasticsearch --version`):
7.0.1
**Plugins installed**: []
None
**Description of the problem including expected versus actual behavior**:
Rollup caps endpoint and aliases on remote clusters

Any ML job based on cross cluster search and an alias like "cluster_two:monitoring-es" fails. This was narrowed down to the following which also fails : 
```
GET cluster_two:monitoring-es/_rollup/data
```

stack trace : 
```
{"type": "server", "timestamp": "2019-05-08T13:22:37,462+0000", "level": "DEBUG", "component": "r.suppressed", "cluster.name": "cluster0", "node.name": "es0", "cluster.uuid": "rTFY3KlpRa-FCxIuwHzxdA", "node.id": "ywH_S8sjS76Gar0m7v1fdg",  "message": "path: /cluster_two:monitoring-es/_rollup/data, params: {pretty=, index=cluster_two:monitoring-es}" , 
"stacktrace": ["org.elasticsearch.index.IndexNotFoundException: no such index [cluster_two:monitoring-es]",
"at org.elasticsearch.cluster.metadata.IndexNameExpressionResolver$WildcardExpressionResolver.indexNotFoundException(IndexNameExpressionResolver.java:747) ~[elasticsearch-7.0.1.jar:7.0.1]",
"at org.elasticsearch.cluster.metadata.IndexNameExpressionResolver$WildcardExpressionResolver.innerResolve(IndexNameExpressionResolver.java:699) ~[elasticsearch-7.0.1.jar:7.0.1]",
"at org.elasticsearch.cluster.metadata.IndexNameExpressionResolver$WildcardExpressionResolver.resolve(IndexNameExpressionResolver.java:655) ~[elasticsearch-7.0.1.jar:7.0.1]",
"at org.elasticsearch.cluster.metadata.IndexNameExpressionResolver.concreteIndices(IndexNameExpressionResolver.java:163) ~[elasticsearch-7.0.1.jar:7.0.1]",
"at org.elasticsearch.cluster.metadata.IndexNameExpressionResolver.concreteIndexNames(IndexNameExpressionResolver.java:142) ~[elasticsearch-7.0.1.jar:7.0.1]",
"at org.elasticsearch.cluster.metadata.IndexNameExpressionResolver.concreteIndexNames(IndexNameExpressionResolver.java:102) ~[elasticsearch-7.0.1.jar:7.0.1]",
"at org.elasticsearch.xpack.rollup.action.TransportGetRollupIndexCapsAction.doExecute(TransportGetRollupIndexCapsAction.java:49) ~[?:?]",
...
```

This seems to come from[ this code](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/7.0/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/cluster/metadata/IndexNameExpressionResolver.java#L695-L699)

**Steps to reproduce**:

 1. set up [cross cluster search](https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/elasticsearch/reference/current/modules-cross-cluster-search.html)
 2. On cluster_two add an index alias
 3. On cluster_one, add pattern "cluster_two:aliasname" and check data can be read from Discover
 4. Define any ML job against this patter will fail to start data feed ("cluster_two:aliasname*" works around)
 5. Also the following will fail when not wildcarded:
```
GET cluster_two:aliasname/_rollup/data
```
